_doc: Manual video -> card mapping for scripts/sync_card_videos.py. Only long-form videos listed under 'videos' are embedded. Single-card review -> that card; head-to-head -> both cards; roundup/persona -> only the clear main picks (max ~4). Unknown/unsure videos go under 'skip' with a reason. Optional per-video keys: 'description' (short blurb override), 'title' (display-title override). Card slugs are validated against the live card sheet. Merge-safe: the sync never drops a video that is already embedded; to take one off the site, list it under 'remove' as {"<videoId>": "reason"}.
